Checkbox

Make multiple selections from a set of alternatives (minimum version: 24.6.0)

Sample Code

Basic Usage


<maui-checkbox value='{{ checked }}' bind:change='onChange'>checkbox</maui-checkbox>

Page({
  data: {
    checked: true,
  },

  onChange(event) {
    this.setData({
      checked: event.detail,
    });
  },
});

Disabled State

The checkbox can be disabled by setting the disabled attribute.


<maui-checkbox disabled value='{{ checked }}' bind:change='onChange'>
  checkbox
</maui-checkbox>

Custom Shape

The shape attribute can control the shape of the checkbox. For example, when set to square, the checkbox shape will become a square.


<maui-checkbox value='{{ checked }}' shape='square' bind:change='onChange'>
  checkbox
</maui-checkbox>

Custom Color

The checked-color attribute can customize the color of the icon in the checked state.


<maui-checkbox
  value='{{ checked }}'
  checked-color='#07c160'
  bind:change='onChange'
>
  checkbox
</maui-checkbox>

Custom Size

The icon-size attribute can customize the size of the icon.


<maui-checkbox value='{{ checked }}' icon-size='25px'>checkbox</maui-checkbox>

Custom Icon

The custom-icon attribute can customize the icon when selected


<maui-checkbox value='{{ checked }}' custom-icon='../example/icon.png'>checkbox</maui-checkbox>

Disable Label Click

Set the label-disabled attribute to disable clicks on the checkbox text.


<maui-checkbox value='{{ checked }}' label-disabled>checkbox</maui-checkbox>

Checkbox Group

Need to be used with maui-checkbox-group. The selected value is an array, bound to maui-checkbox-group through value above, the items in the array are the values set by the name attribute of the selected Checkbox.


<maui-checkbox-group value='{{ result }}' bind:change='onChange'>
  <maui-checkbox name='a'>checkbox a</maui-checkbox>
  <maui-checkbox name='b'>checkbox b</maui-checkbox>
  <maui-checkbox name='c'>checkbox c</maui-checkbox>
</maui-checkbox-group>

Page({
  data: {
    result: ['a', 'b'],
  },

  onChange(event) {
    this.setData({
      result: event.detail,
    });
  },
});

限制最大可选数


<maui-checkbox-group value='{{ result }}' bind:change='onChange' max='{{ 2 }}'>
  <maui-checkbox name='a'>复选框 a</maui-checkbox>
  <maui-checkbox name='b'>复选框 b</maui-checkbox>
  <maui-checkbox name='c'>复选框 c</maui-checkbox>
</maui-checkbox-group>

API

Checkbox Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
name Identifies the Checkbox name String -
shape Shape, optional values are round square String round
value Whether it is selected Boolean false
disabled Whether to disable the radio button Boolean false
label-disabled Whether to disable clicks on radio button content Boolean false
label-position Text position, optional value is left String right
custom-icon Custom icon, support name and image link Boolean false
checked-color Selected state color String #1989fa
icon-size icon size String | Number 20px

CheckboxGroup Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
name Identifier when submitting within the form String -
value The names of all selected items Array -
disabled Whether to disable all radio buttons Boolean false
max Set the maximum number of options Number 0(no limit)
direction Arrangement direction, optional value is horizontal String vertical

Checkbox Event

Event Description Parameter
bind:change Event triggered when bound value changes The value of the current component

CheckboxGroup Event

Event Description Parameter
bind:change Event triggered when bound value changes The value of the current component

Checkbox Slot

Name Description
- Custom text
